###data upload

```{r}
legume_df <- read_csv("legume.shoot.root.amf.rhizobia.csv") %>% mutate(Mutualist=case_when(Mutualist=="control"~"Control", Mutualist=="A"~"AMF", Mutualist=="Rh"~"Rhizobia", Mutualist=="RhA"~"AMF+Rhizobia")) %>% mutate( Carbon = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400","600","1000")))
str(legume_df)
legume_df$Chamber=as.character(legume_df$Chamber)
legume_df$Carbon=as.character(legume_df$Carbon)

#checking normality and transforming shoot biomass
hist(legume_df$Shoot_biomass_g)
legume_df$log_shoot.biomass <- log(legume_df$Shoot_biomass_g)

#checking normality and transforming root biomass
hist(legume_df$Root_biomass_g)
legume_df$log_root.biomass <- log(legume_df$Root_biomass_g)
hist(legume_df$log_root.biomass)

```

#Shoot and root biomass
```{r}
#model shoot biomass
colnames(legume_df)
model_shoot <- lmer(log(Shoot_biomass_g)~ Carbon* Mutualist + (1  + Mutualist| Chamber), data = legume_df)
summary(model_shoot)
anova(model_shoot)

#Model diagnostics
#Extract residuals and fitted values
residuals <- resid(model_shoot)
fitted <- fitted(model_shoot)

#Residuals vs fitted (check for homoscedasticity)
plot(fitted, residuals, 
     xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

hist(residuals, breaks = 20, main = "Histogram of residuals")
emmeans(model_shoot, pairwise ~ Mutualist | Carbon, type = "response")

cld_shoot <- cld(emmeans(model_shoot, ~ Mutualist | Carbon), Letters = letters) %>% mutate(Biomass_Type="Shoot")


#model root biomass
model_root <- lmer(log(Root_biomass_g)~ Carbon* Mutualist + (1  + Mutualist| Chamber), data = legume_df)
summary(model_root)
anova(model_root)
#Extract residuals and fitted values
residuals <- resid(model_root)
fitted <- fitted(model_root)

#Residuals vs fitted (check for homoscedasticity)
plot(fitted, residuals, 
     xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

hist(residuals, breaks = 20, main = "Histogram of residuals")
emmeans(model_root, pairwise ~ Mutualist | Carbon, type = "response")

cld_root <- cld(emmeans(model_root, ~ Mutualist | Carbon), Letters = letters)%>% mutate(Biomass_Type="Root")

# Combine both
cld_combined <- bind_rows(cld_shoot, cld_root)

# Data for plotting
legume_df2 <- legume_df %>%
  mutate(Root_biomass_g = -Root_biomass_g)    # flip roots for plotting

legume.plot <- legume_df2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, Shoot_biomass_g, Root_biomass_g) %>% pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(Shoot_biomass_g, Root_biomass_g),
    names_to  = "Biomass_Type",
    values_to = "Biomass"
  ) %>% mutate(Biomass_Type = recode(Biomass_Type,
                          "Shoot_biomass_g" = "Shoot",
                          "Root_biomass_g"  = "Root"), Carbon = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400", "600", "1000")))

legume.summary <- legume.plot %>%
  group_by(Carbon, Mutualist, Biomass_Type) %>%
 dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE   = sd(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Estimated marginal means on the model (log) scale
emm_root  <- emmeans(model_root,  ~ Carbon * Mutualist)
emm_shoot <- emmeans(model_shoot, ~ Carbon * Mutualist)

# Tukey significant letters
cld_root <- cld(emm_root, alpha   = 0.05, Letters = letters,adjust  = "tukey")

cld_shoot <- cld(emm_shoot, alpha   = 0.05, Letters = letters,adjust  = "tukey")

# tag as Root vs Shoot
letters_root <- as.data.frame(cld_root) %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, .group) %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass_Type = "Root",
    sig_letter   = tolower(stringr::str_trim(.group))   
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-.group)

letters_shoot <- as.data.frame(cld_shoot) %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, .group) %>%
  mutate(
    Biomass_Type = "Shoot",
    sig_letter   = toupper(stringr::str_trim(.group)) 
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-.group)

letters_all <- bind_rows(letters_root, letters_shoot)

#join letters to summary
legume.summary2 <- legume.summary %>% left_join(letters_all,
            by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist", "Biomass_Type")) %>% mutate( label_text = round(abs(Mean), 2), sig_y = ifelse(
      Biomass_Type == "Root",
      Mean - SE - 0.2,  
      Mean + SE + 0.2 ),
    num_y = ifelse(
      Biomass_Type == "Root",
      Mean - SE - 0.18,
      Mean + SE + 0.18
    ))

# Plot
root.shoot.fig <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = legume.summary2,
    aes(x = Carbon, y = Mean, fill = Mutualist),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width    = 0.75,
    alpha    = 0.9,
    color    = "black"
  ) + geom_errorbar(
    data = legume.summary2,
    aes(x = Carbon,
        ymin = Mean - SE,
        ymax = Mean + SE,
        group = Mutualist),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width    = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) + geom_text(
    data = legume.summary2,
    aes(x = Carbon, y = sig_y, label = sig_letter, group = Mutualist),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    size = 6
  ) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) + labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
    y = "Biomass (g)"
  ) + scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Microbial Treatment",
    values = c("bisque4", "brown", "royalblue", "magenta4")
  ) + scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-2, 3, 0.5),
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    labels = function(x) abs(round(x, 2))
  ) + theme_classic(base_size = 24) + theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.line       = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks      = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.6,
    y = max(legume.summary2$Mean[legume.summary2$Biomass_Type == "Shoot"]) + 0.3,
    label = "Shoot biomass", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.6,
    y = min(legume.summary2$Mean[legume.summary2$Biomass_Type == "Root"]) - 0.3,
    label = "Root biomass", hjust = 0, size = 6, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1.5))

ggsave("root.shoot.png", root.shoot.fig, dpi=300, width = 12, height = 7, units = "in")
```

#AM fungal colonization and Nodule presence/absence
```{r}
###########nodule number (creating binary category)
legume_df$nod_binary <- ifelse(legume_df$nod_number> 0, 1, 0)


model_nod_bin <- glmer(
  nod_binary ~ Carbon * Mutualist + (1 | Chamber),
  family = binomial,
  data = legume_df
)
summary(model_nod_bin)
Anova(model_nod_bin, type = 3)

#model diagnostics
res_nod <- simulateResiduals(model_nod_bin, n = 500)
plot(res_nod)

#emmeans

emm_nod <- emmeans(model_nod_bin, ~ Mutualist)

cld_nod <- cld(
  emm_nod,
  Letters = LETTERS,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

letters_nod <- as.data.frame(cld_nod) %>%
  transmute(
    Mutualist,
    sig_nod = toupper(trimws(.group))
  )

# summary for plotting
nod_simple <- plot_df2 %>%
  group_by(Mutualist) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_nod = mean(mean_nod, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_nod   = sqrt(sum(se_nod^2)) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(letters_nod, by = "Mutualist") %>%
  mutate(
    nod_y = mean_nod + se_nod + 0.08
  )

# plot
p_nod <- ggplot(nod_simple,
                aes(x = Mutualist, y = mean_nod, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_nod - se_nod,
                    ymax = mean_nod + se_nod),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(y = nod_y, label = sig_nod),
            size = 6, fontface = "plain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Microbial Treatment") +
  labs(x = "Microbial Treatment",
       y = "Nodules presence/absence") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(nod_simple$nod_y, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.title.x    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

##########AM fungal colonization #####

model_amf <- lmer(AMF_colonization_percent ~ Carbon * Mutualist+ (1  + Mutualist| Chamber), data = legume_df)
anova(model_amf)
emm_amf <- emmeans(model_amf, ~ Carbon * Mutualist)

cld_amf <- cld(emm_amf, Letters = LETTERS,adjust  = "tukey")

letters_amf <- as.data.frame(cld_amf) %>%
  transmute(
    Carbon,
    Mutualist,
    sig_amf = str_trim(.group)  
  ) %>% mutate(sig_amf = toupper(sig_amf))

##create a dataset with mean, se, and significant letters

plot_df <- legume_df %>%
  group_by(Carbon, Mutualist) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_amf = mean(AMF_colonization_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_amf   = sd(AMF_colonization_percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(AMF_colonization_percent))),
    mean_nod = mean(nod_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_nod   = sd(nod_binary, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(nod_binary))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
###join nodule and amf significant letters for plotting
plot_df2 <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(letters_amf, by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist")) %>%
  left_join(letters_nod, by = c( "Mutualist")) %>%
  mutate(
    amf_y = mean_amf + se_amf + 4,    
    nod_y = mean_nod + se_nod + 0.7 
  )

## plot AMF colonization 
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
levels(factor(plot_df2$Mutualist))

colors <- c(
  "Control"      = "bisque4",
  "Rhizobia"     = "brown",
  "AMF"          = "royalblue",
  "AMF+Rhizobia" = "magenta4"
)
p_amf <- ggplot(plot_df2,
                aes(x = Carbon, y = mean_amf, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_amf - se_amf,
                    ymax = mean_amf + se_amf),
                position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(y = amf_y, label = sig_amf, group = Mutualist),
            position = dodge, size = 6, fontface = "plain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Microbial Treatment") +
  labs(x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
       y = "AMF colonization (%)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(plot_df2$amf_y, na.rm = TRUE) + 1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )



#Combine amf and nodule number figures

p_amf2 <- p_amf + theme(legend.position = "top")

p_nod2 <- p_nod + theme(legend.position = "top")

final_fig <- ggarrange(
  p_amf2,
  p_nod2,
  ncol = 2,
  labels = c("A)", "B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"),  
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "top"
)

final_fig
ggsave("nod.amf.new.png", final_fig, dpi=300, width = 18, height = 10, units = "in")
```

#plant nutrients
```{r}
Nutrient <- read_csv("Nutrient.csv")
str(Nutrient)
Nutrient$carbon=as.character(Nutrient$carbon)
Nutrient$chamber=as.character(Nutrient$chamber)

unique(Nutrient$Mutualist)

Nutrient.final <- Nutrient %>% dplyr::rename(Carbon = carbon) %>%  mutate(Mutualist=case_when(Mutualist=="control"~"Control", Mutualist=="amf"~"AMF", Mutualist=="rhizobia"~"Rhizobia", Mutualist=="both"~"AMF+Rhizobia"))%>% mutate( Carbon = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400","600","1000")))

colnames(Nutrient.final)

## Color scheme
colors <- c(
  "Control"      = "bisque4",
  "Rhizobia"     = "brown",
  "AMF"          = "royalblue",
  "AMF+Rhizobia" = "magenta4"
)

# Summaries
nutrient_summary <- Nutrient.final %>%
  group_by(Carbon, Mutualist) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_N = mean(N_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_N   = sd(N_percent,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(N_percent))),
    mean_P = mean(P_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_P   = sd(P_percent,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(P_percent))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#models
model_N <- lm(N_percent ~ Carbon * Mutualist, data = Nutrient.final)
model_P <- lm(P_percent ~ Carbon * Mutualist, data = Nutrient.final)
anova(model_N)
anova(model_P)

#emmeans and significant letters
emm_N <- emmeans(model_N, ~ Carbon * Mutualist)
emm_P <- emmeans(model_P, ~ Carbon * Mutualist)

cld_N <- cld(emm_N, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, sig_N = .group) %>% mutate(sig_N = toupper(sig_N))

cld_P <- cld(emm_P, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, sig_P = .group) %>% mutate(sig_P = toupper(sig_P))

## Merge letters into summary and set y-positions
nutrient_summary2 <- nutrient_summary %>%
  left_join(cld_N, by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist")) %>%
  left_join(cld_P, by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist")) %>%
  mutate(
    y_N = mean_N + se_N + 0.06, 
    y_P = mean_P + se_P + 0.006
  )


#plot nitrogen
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
p_N <- ggplot(nutrient_summary2,
              aes(x = Carbon, y = mean_N, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_N - se_N,
                    ymax = mean_N + se_N),
                position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(y = y_N, label = sig_N),
            position = dodge, vjust = -0.3, hjust=0.55, size = 4, fontface = "plain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors,
                    name = "Microbial Treatment") +
  labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
    y = "Plant N (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(nutrient_summary2$y_N, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

#plot phosphorus
p_P <- ggplot(nutrient_summary2,
              aes(x = Carbon, y = mean_P, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_P - se_P,
                    ymax = mean_P + se_P),
                position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(y = y_P, label = sig_P),
            position = dodge, vjust = -1.6,hjust=0.6, size = 4, fontface = "plain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors,
                    name = "Microbial Treatment") +
  labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
    y = "Plant P (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(nutrient_summary2$y_P, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.005)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

#combine N and P figures
final_nutrient_fig <- ggarrange(
  p_N,
  p_P,
  ncol = 2,
  labels = c("A)", "B)"),
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"),
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "top",
  widths = c(1, 1),   
  align = "hv"
)

final_nutrient_fig
ggsave("n.p.new.png", final_nutrient_fig, dpi=300, width = 12, height = 7, units = "in")
```

##Synergy index

```{r}
synergy_df <- legume_df %>% mutate(AMF_proportion= AMF_colonization_percent/100) %>%
  mutate(
    Carbon    = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400", "600", "1000")),
    Mutualist = factor(Mutualist,
                       levels = c("Control", "Rhizobia", "AMF", "AMF+Rhizobia")),
    total_biomass = Shoot_biomass_g + Root_biomass_g 
  )

# Linear model
m_biom <- lm(total_biomass ~ Carbon * Mutualist, data = synergy_df)

# Estimated marginal means for each CO2 x mutualist treatment
emm_biom <- emmeans(m_biom, ~ Mutualist | Carbon)


# synergy contrast = Dual + Control - AMF - Rhizobia
syn_contr <- contrast(
  emm_biom,
  list(
    synergy = c(
      "Control"      =  1,
      "Rhizobia"     = -1,
      "AMF"          = -1,
      "AMF+Rhizobia" =  1
    )
  ),
  by = "Carbon"
)
syn_df <- as.data.frame(syn_contr)
syn_df <- as.data.frame(confint(syn_contr))

gg_syn <- ggplot(syn_df,
                 aes(x = Carbon, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
    y = "Synergy index"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

gg_syn

```

##root:shoot ratio
```{r}
#Add root:shoot ratio
root_shoot_df <- legume_df %>%
  mutate(
    Carbon    = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400", "600", "1000")),
    Mutualist = factor(Mutualist,
                       levels = c("Control", "Rhizobia", "AMF", "AMF+Rhizobia")),
    root_shoot = Root_biomass_g / Shoot_biomass_g       
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(root_shoot))       
#Model
model_rs <- lm(root_shoot ~ Carbon * Mutualist, data = root_shoot_df)
anova(model_rs)

#emmeans and significant letters
emm_rs <- emmeans(model_rs, ~ Mutualist | Carbon)

cld_rs <- cld(emm_rs, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, sig_rs = .group) %>% mutate(sig_rs = toupper(sig_rs))

rs_summary <- root_shoot_df %>%
  group_by(Carbon, Mutualist) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_rs = mean(root_shoot, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rs   = sd(root_shoot,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(root_shoot))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cld_rs, by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist")) %>%
  mutate(
    y_lab = mean_rs + se_rs + 0.05 )

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

p_rs <- ggplot(rs_summary,
               aes(x = Carbon, y = mean_rs, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rs - se_rs,
                    ymax = mean_rs + se_rs),
                position = dodge, width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(y = y_lab, label = sig_rs),
            position = dodge, size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors,
                    name = "Microbial Treatment") +
  labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~Treatment),
    y = "Root:shoot"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(rs_summary$y_lab, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 24) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "plain"),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 24),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

p_rs
final_fig_biomass <- ggarrange(root.shoot.fig, p_rs, gg_syn,
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("A)", "B)", "C)"),
  font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"),
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "top"
)


final_fig_biomass
ggsave("biomass.new.png", final_fig_biomass, dpi=300, width = 12, height = 16, units = "in")
```

##nodule number
```{r}
nod_pos <- subset(
  legume_df,
  nod_number > 0 & Mutualist %in% c("Rhizobia", "AMF+Rhizobia")
)

#model
m_nod_count_pois <- glmer(
  nod_number ~ Carbon * Mutualist + (1 | Chamber),
  family = poisson,
  data = nod_pos
)
Anova(m_nod_count_pois, type = 3)
#overdispersion check
overdisp_ratio <- sum(residuals(m_nod_count_pois, type = "pearson")^2) /
                  m_nod_count_pois$df.residual
overdisp_ratio #no overdispersion, so the model is good

nod_pos$Carbon <- factor(nod_pos$Carbon, levels = c("400", "600", "1000"))

# emmeans model
emm_nod <- emmeans(m_nod_count_pois, ~ Carbon * Mutualist)

# significant letters
nod_cld <- cld(emm_nod, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Carbon = factor(Carbon, levels = c("400","600","1000")))


# Colors 
colors <- c(
  "Control"      = "bisque4",
  "Rhizobia"     = "brown",
  "AMF"          = "royalblue",
  "AMF+Rhizobia" = "magenta4")

# nodule number among nodulated plants
nod_summary <- nod_pos %>%
  group_by(Carbon, Mutualist) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_nod = mean(nod_number),
    se_nod   = sd(nod_number) / sqrt(n()),
    n        = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

nod_summary_lab <- nod_summary %>%
  left_join(nod_cld %>% dplyr::select(Carbon, Mutualist, .group),
            by = c("Carbon", "Mutualist")) %>%
  mutate(
    letters = trimws(.group), 
    label_y = mean_nod + se_nod + 0.3   
  )
# Position dodge for grouped bars
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

# Bar plot
p_nod_intensity <- ggplot(nod_summary_lab,
                          aes(x = Carbon, y = mean_nod, fill = Mutualist)) +
  geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.6, color = "black", alpha = 0.95) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_nod - se_nod, ymax = mean_nod + se_nod),
    width = 0.15,
    position = dodge,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # --- LETTERS ---
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = letters, group = Mutualist),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Microbial treatment") +
  labs(
    x = expression(CO[2]~treatment~"(ppm)"),
    y = "Nodule number (nodulated plants only)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.border    = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
  )

p_nod_intensity
```
